title: Servitude
wikitext: '''Servitude''' simplifies pet interactions, prioritizes critical targets, and provides real-time alerts allowing you to focus more on the fight and less on micromanagement. == '''Installation''' == '''Manual Installation only''' # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Extract the .zip file, move the Servitude folder from inside the Servitude_v060519.0 folder to your Interface/AddOns directory # Restart the game. '''Optional''': AssistHelper == Git Links == * [https://github.com/crazypoultry/Wow1.12.1_Addons_Collection '''(crazypoultry)'''] == How to Use Servitude == # Type /servitude or /serv to open the configuration UI. # Use the command /servitude set [name] to prioritize a party/raid member for devouring debuffs. # Use /servitude clear to reset the priority. # Enable or disable features like auto-sacrifice, invisibility, and spell lock within the UI. # For quick actions, bind keys: #* Primary action: /servitude primary (or via keybinding) #* Secondary action: /servitude secondary == Commands == {| class="fandom-table" !Command !Description |- |/servitude or /serv |Open the configuration UI for the addon |- |/servitude set [name] |Set a specific party/raid member as the priority for auto-devour (or use current target if no name) |- |/servitude clear |Clear the current priority unit |- |/servitude show |Show the Servitude Message frame for alerts |- |/servitude help |Display help information about commands |} == Features == '''Pet Management''' * The addon automatically manages pet spells like Devour Magic, Dispel Magic, Sacrifice, and Invisibility based on your settings. * You can set a priority unit to focus on devouring debuffs from specific raid/party members. '''Spell Lock & Anti-Interrupt''' * Detects enemy spells and can automatically lock or interrupt dangerous spells in PvP/PvE. * Customize behaviors via settings. '''In-Combat & Out-of-Combat Automation''' * The addon intelligently manages spells depending on combat status. * It can automatically sacrifice or devour based on health ratios and combat situation. '''Visual & Audio Alerts''' * Alerts and notifications appear on-screen. * Optional sound alerts for specific events (e.g., spell lock, devour, sacrifice). '''Custom Colors & Messages''' * Configure message colors and alert frames for personalized display. == Preview == [[File:Serv.png|frameless|580x580px]] [[Category:Addon]]
